user.title: Choose a connection mode
user.description: Choose whether Home Assistant should connect through the MOVA cloud API or directly to a device over HTTP.

local.title: Connect to a local MOVA device
local.description: Enter the host and port of the MOVA HTTP device. The device will be queried before the integration is added.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address reachable from Home Assistant.
data_description.port: HTTP port exposed by the device.

cloud.title: Sign in to MOVA cloud
cloud.description: Sign in with your MOVA account, then choose a device group. The password is RSA encrypted before submission and is not saved.

data_description.cloud_environment: UAT is available now. CN and EU are reserved for later use.
data_description.password: Your plaintext account password; the integration encrypts it with the UAT public key.

reconfigure.description: Update the credentials for this integration.

data_description.username: The account name you use to sign in to the device.

reconfigure_local.title: Reconfigure local MOVA device
reconfigure_local.description: Update the host and port used to reach this device.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address reachable from Home Assistant.
data_description.port: HTTP port exposed by the device.

reconfigure_cloud.title: Reconfigure MOVA cloud connection
reconfigure_cloud.description: Sign in with your MOVA account, then confirm the existing device group. The password is RSA encrypted before submission and is not saved.

data_description.cloud_environment: UAT is available now. CN and EU are reserved for later use.
data_description.password: Your plaintext account password; the integration encrypts it with the UAT public key.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate integration
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {username} are no longer valid. Provide updated credentials to restore access.

data_description.username: The account name you use to sign in to the device.
data_description.password: The current password for that account.

reauth_cloud.title: Sign in to MOVA cloud again
reauth_cloud.description: Your cloud session has expired or this entry has not signed in yet. Sign in to restore access to the same device group.

data_description.cloud_environment: UAT is available now. CN and EU are reserved for later use.
data_description.password: Your plaintext account password; the integration encrypts it with the UAT public key.

cloud_group.title: Choose a MOVA device group
cloud_group.description: Choose a group from your account. Home Assistant will check its device list before adding the integration.

data_description.group_id: Group names come from your MOVA account. The corresponding group ID is used for all device requests.

reconfigure_cloud_group.title: Confirm the MOVA device group
reconfigure_cloud_group.description: Select the existing device group to update this integration. Add another integration to connect a different group.

data_description.group_id: Choose the same group as this integration to preserve its devices and entities.

reauth_cloud_group.title: Confirm the MOVA device group
reauth_cloud_group.description: Select the existing device group to restore access.

data_description.group_id: Choose the same group as this integration to preserve its devices and entities.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the server.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password is wrong.
error.no_devices: The device group did not return any devices.
error.no_groups: This account did not return any device groups. Check the account and its group permissions, then try again.
error.invalid_group: Choose a device group returned by your account.
error.cloud_group_access_denied: Login succeeded, but the group list request was denied. Check the token header and API permissions.
error.invalid_cloud_url: Enter an HTTPS API base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
error.environment_not_available: This cloud environment is not available yet.
error.cloud_login_rejected: The cloud login service rejected the request. Check the account, password, tenant and password encoding; see the MOVA token exchange warning in the HA log.
error.cloud_client_rejected: The cloud rejected the application client credentials (Basic authorization). Check the UAT client configuration.
error.cloud_password_decryption_failed: The cloud could not decrypt the password. Check the RSA public key and the password URL encoding.
error.cloud_verification_required: The cloud requires a verification code or captcha that this login form does not support.
error.cloud_login_request_rejected: The cloud rejected the login request parameters or OAuth grant. See the MOVA token exchange warning in the HA log.
error.cloud_device_access_denied: Login succeeded, but the device list request was denied. Check the token header, API permissions and device group access.

abort.cloud_session_expired: The setup session is no longer available. Start adding the integration again.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This group differs from the existing integration. Add another integration to connect a different group.

data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to fetch the device state, between 0.25 and 24 hours.

cloud_config_readback_failed.message: The command was submitted, but reading the actual settings failed. Check the settings after the next refresh before submitting another command.

cloud_config_rejected.message: The cloud did not submit the command. The configuration type may be unsupported or the device group may be empty.

config_write_failed.message: Failed to write device parameters. Check the connection and try again.

config_write_rejected.message: The device did not accept the write. Actual settings have been read back. If the device just restarted, try again shortly.

invalid_config_value.message: Choose a supported work mode or an integer within the allowed parameter range.

authentication_failed.message: Authentication failed during the data update.

update_failed.message: Failed to fetch data from the device: {error}

switch_set_failed.message: Failed to change the {name} setting on the device.

number_set_failed.message: Failed to set the target humidity on the device.

reset_filter_failed.message: Failed to reset the filter timer on the device.

fan_speed_set_failed.message: Failed to change the fan speed on the device.

fan_state_set_failed.message: Failed to turn the fan on or off.

invalid_fan_speed.message: {speed} is not a fan speed this device supports.

entry_not_found.message: No configuration entry of this integration matches {target}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The configuration entry {target} is not loaded, so it cannot be refreshed.

refresh_data.name: Refresh data
refresh_data.description: Fetches the current device state immediately instead of waiting for the next poll.
